added.summary: Tilt-shift depth of field, the miniature look: above 0 the sharp band is a strip across the middle of the image, this fraction of its height above and below the centre line, instead of a range of depths, so it holds whatever the camera's distance; the blur grows above the strip as far and below it as near, to dofMaxBlur at dofTiltShift times (1 + dofFalloff) past its edge. 0 focuses by depth as before.
